Mira Patel: hey all, first day on an M2 mac. installed brew to /opt/homebrew and asdf via brew but python/node still point to system installs. any quick fixes? :wave:
DevX Bot: welcome! paste outputs of `which python`, `which node`, and `echo $PATH` so we can triage.
Mira Patel: which python -> /usr/bin/python3, which node -> /usr/local/bin/node, echo $PATH -> /usr/bin:/usr/local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:~/.asdf/shims
Samir: PATH order is the issue. on arm macs you want /opt/homebrew/bin and asdf shims before system paths. add to your rc: `export PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:$HOME/.asdf/shims:$PATH"` and source asdf: `. $(brew --prefix asdf)/libexec/asdf.sh`
Luca R.: run `brew --prefix asdf` to confirm libexec path. also add zsh completions if you use zsh: `fpath+=$(brew --prefix asdf)/share/zsh/site-functions`
Mira Patel: updated rc, restarted shell. `which python` -> ~/.asdf/shims/python but python --version is 3.8, want 3.11.
Samir: install and set global: `asdf plugin-add python && asdf install python 3.11.4 && asdf global python 3.11.4 && asdf reshim`
Kate: for node use asdf-nodejs plugin and import its keyring if needed: `bash ~/.asdf/plugins/nodejs/bin/import-release-team-keyring`. also remove any NVM lines in your rc that can interfere.
Mira Patel: found `source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh` in my .zshrc. removed it, reshim, node -v -> v18.16.0. thanks! :thumbsup:
Luca R.: pro tip: launch VS Code from terminal (`code .`) so it inherits PATH. check `asdf which python`/`asdf which node` if things look off.
Mira Patel: where are company dotfiles? want git config and hooks.
Samir: we keep them at https://github.com/redwood-inference/dotfiles. clone and run `./setup.sh` to symlink and enable hooks.
Mira Patel: cloning now. thanks everyone, tagging @Luca R. if setup script chokes.
Luca R.: ping me if it fails. happy first day! :tada:
